title: Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed): one-property twin (boundary)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the value is cut, extended or delimited so that it no longer ends where the format ends. Legacy mutation notes: the documented ddapp_ prefix's underscore replaced by a dash (ddapp-); body unchanged. Twin of "Datadog Application key (ddapp_-prefixed): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of datadog-application-key-http-header: the documented ddapp_ prefix's underscore replaced by a dash (ddapp-); body unchanged. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
